title: Continuity metrics ambiguous-baseline count is always zero
summary: GET /api/projects/:id/continuity-metrics counts shots whose location_match_source equals 'ambiguous', but migration 039's CHECK constraint allows only manual, resolver_exact, resolver_alias, resolver_fuzzy, stage7_inferred, legacy_backfill and camera_direction_parent, and no writer stores 'ambiguous' (ambiguity is a boolean on the resolver result). ambiguousBaselineLocations is therefore always 0.
notes: Read directly in this pass. related holds merged WD-IMPL ids. The strict-validation list in the same route does not use this counter.

title: Continuity metrics suggestion rules
summary: continuity-metrics returns advisory suggestions: 'Several shots share one location; Advanced Continuity can reduce background drift.' when the most-used location appears in four or more shots and continuity_mode is not advanced; 'Some shots are using fallback location references; Stage 8 direction coverage would strengthen them.' when any shot uses a fallback reference; and 'Approved frames can be reused as Stage 10 continuity bases...' when no shot has a base selected or generated from a base and at least three shots exist.
notes: Computed per request, never stored. The suggestion strip that displays these is basic-mode only (LocationCoveragePanel.tsx, per V7 section 4.4). The test that covers the route (WD-IMPL-TEST-0030) was not checked for suggestion text.

title: Establish-view prompt appears for any shot with an assigned camera direction
summary: Stage 10 renders EstablishViewPrompt for the selected shot's start frame whenever the shot's camera_direction_id resolves in the direction lookup, whether or not the direction already has an image. The component chooses gap-fill copy ('This fills a coverage gap!') when the direction has no image and a replace AlertDialog that overwrites the existing reference when it has one; the lock copy says future shots using the direction will reference the new image.
notes: Read directly in this pass. Shots without an assigned direction get no prompt (no dropdown alternative). Persistence is via the establish-from-frame route (projectAssets.ts:3193).

title: Stage 7 shot list has no camera-direction control
summary: The Stage 7 shot list shows a location source label of 'Direction' for camera_direction_parent (Stage7ShotList.tsx:372-373) and offers location select, clear and candidate accept (1310-1353, 1432), but nothing in the file reads or writes shots.camera_direction_id. The only UI that assigns a direction is the Stage 8 coverage panel's per-shot select, which calls PUT .../camera-direction.
notes: Checked with case-insensitive grep for camera and direction in Stage7ShotList.tsx; the only hits were merge-direction state, the source label and the camera text field. The Stage 7 shot-list route PUT camera-direction exists server side (projects.ts:2180) but has no Stage 7 caller.

title: Generation prompt labels location references MAIN REFERENCE or FALLBACK DIRECTION
summary: The numbered reference list in generation prompts labels each location direction image 'MAIN REFERENCE' when the shot has an assigned direction and 'FALLBACK DIRECTION' otherwise, appends a [DELTA: ...] clause when the angle differs, and assigns reference role location_direction_main or location_asset_fallback. The labels are prompt text produced at Stage 9 prompt generation, separate from the continuity preview's ContinuityPreviewPanel labels.
notes: Read directly in this pass. The strategy that picks each label is computed at promptGenerationService.ts:415-433. Whether the labels reach a model in every path was not traced beyond prompt assembly.
